svg.title: Diagram key
svg.desc: The key to every diagram in this repository, read top to bottom. Nodes and status: a solid box is built; a box with a green fill and outline is the one highlighted built node a diagram may have; a solid box with the warn pill 'partly built' is partly built, and its missing part is a dashed chip that names its milestone, here 'planned · M4'; a dashed box with a dashed pill such as 'planned · M5' is planned and names its milestone. A red box is an outcome that a guard refuses. A plain note with a folded corner is a note, joined to its subject by a dotted leader; a yellow folded note is a gap or caveat, and its text starts 'Gap:' or 'Caveat:'. A green numbered circle is a step that matches the numbered list beside the image, and the letter A marks the administrator path. Groups, frames and shapes: a grey rounded panel is a group, lane or Region, and also a compose project or a workflow card; a box with a green header band is an AWS CloudFormation stack, the band holding the stack name in monospace, here BranchbookRelease; a dashed frame with no band and the pill 'planned · after M6' is a planned stack, here BranchbookApp; a box with a thin accent band along its top and a badge is the long form of a gate, the badge naming what enforces it, here 'GitHub setting'. A fully rounded pill is a person or a browser, a cylinder is a database, a box with a folded corner is a workflow or file, and a small diamond on an edge is a gate, with its label beside it. Edges: a thin grey arrow is a flow, its label set on a halo; a heavier green arrow is the main path, one per diagram; a dashed arrow is a planned flow, and its label names its milestone; a red arrow crossed at its midpoint is refused or not allowed, and its label starts 'not allowed:' or 'refused:'; a dotted line is a health check or a note leader; where two lines cross, the lower one breaks. Pills: 'built · M2', 'partly built', 'planned · M5', 'planned · after M6', the warn pill 'reports; blocks nothing' and the red pill 'refused'. AWS service tiles carry a 4 px stripe whose colour names the category: orange for compute and containers, magenta for database, violet for networking, red for security, pink for management and integration, and green for storage and cost. The legend row at the foot of each diagram lists only the entries that diagram uses, always in this order: Built, Partly built, Planned with milestone, Main path, Planned flow, Refused or not allowed, Health check, Gap or caveat; the access diagram adds the enforcement badges IAM, GitHub setting, and Code and workflow; AWS diagrams end with AWS category and the stripes they use, each named.

g.text: AWS service tiles: the stripe names the category
Legend: each diagram shows only the entries it uses, in this order
